# Amauri Almeida — Environmental Research Portfolio

> Portfolio of Amauri Almeida de Souza Junior, a Brazilian environmental management technologist and data scientist (AI, machine learning, environmental data analysis) based in São Paulo, Brazil, with field research across Brazil, Argentina and Chile. The site is a static page on GitHub Pages, available in 9 languages (pt, en, es, it, zh, fr, ar, de, el). Each project is a public, open-source Streamlit app built with public data sources and no private API keys.

Main site: https://amaurialmeida.github.io/environmental-portfolio/
Author: https://github.com/amaurialmeida · https://www.linkedin.com/in/amauri-almeida26/ · http://lattes.cnpq.br/9545242042800090
Contact: amauri.almeidasjr@gmail.com

## Flagship tools

- [Greenlog](https://environmental-dashboard-portfolio.streamlit.app/): hub with 12 environmental projects, a live Windy wind map and key indicators (temperature, solar energy, biodiversity, wind, water quality, seismology, invasive species, El Niño). Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/environmental-dashboard
- [Environmental Signal Router](https://environmental-dashboard-portfolio.streamlit.app/signal-router): near real-time 3D globe of earthquakes, wildfires, cyclones, tornadoes, tsunamis, volcanoes and floods. Data: USGS, NASA EONET, NOAA (no API keys), plus an environmental news bulletin.
- [Carbon Footprint Tracker](https://carbon-footprint-tracker-tkfv5pthky3rk2gd8m9mm8.streamlit.app/): interactive 10-question personal footprint calculator. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/carbon-footprint-tracker
- [Urban Environmental Observatory](https://amaurialmeida.github.io/environmental-portfolio/#ueo-section): compares the environmental performance of cities in 15 countries (73 listed: 40 with curated indicators, the rest — mostly Brazilian cities — being collected) (water, comfort, green areas, waste) using curated public data (2023–2024), plus country-level context (forest cover, renewable energy, CO₂, air pollution) from the World Bank open data API (CC BY 4.0).

## Research projects

- [Santa Rita River Observatory](https://santa-rita-river-observatory.streamlit.app/): multi-variable hydrological monitoring (flow, water quality, land-use impact) with USGS time series and anomaly detection; based on a 2016 scientific initiation project. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/santa-rita-river-observatory
- [Solar Plant NW São Paulo](https://solar-university-nw-sp.streamlit.app/): performance analysis of a 1.07 GWh photovoltaic plant (capacity factor, temperature losses, generation vs irradiation). Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/solar-university-nw-sp
- [Bee Colony Collapse](https://bee-colony-collapse-brazil.streamlit.app/): mortality of bees from agricultural chemicals in MG, SP and PR (2016–2022), 338 hives; field interviews, Folium maps, Plotly. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/bee-colony-collapse-brazil
- [Patagonia Wind Energy](https://patagonia-wind-energy.streamlit.app/): Weibull distribution of wind speed, wind power density and installable capacity; Open-Meteo ERA5 and SENAMHI stations. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/patagonia-wind-energy
- [Patagonia Water Quality](https://patagonia-water-quality.streamlit.app/): 18 river stations, 2019–2024, weighted water quality index (IQA) and acidification trends. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/patagonia-water-quality
- [Patagonia Seismic](https://patagonia-seismic.streamlit.app/): seismic activity in the Nazca Plate subduction zone using the USGS catalog; magnitude, depth, risk mapping. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/patagonia-seismic
- [Invasive Alien Species Impact](https://invasive-alien-species-impact.streamlit.app/): vegetation cover classification in Puerto Williams (Chile) using NDVI and multitemporal Sentinel-2, 2015 vs 2024. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/invasive-alien-species-impact
- [Stingless Bee Observatory BR](https://stingless-bee-observatory-br.streamlit.app/): geospatial mapping of 238 stingless bee species in Brazil, overlap with deforestation (PRODES/INPE) and a vulnerability index. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/stingless-bee-observatory-br
- [El Niño 2026 ML Forecast](https://el-nino-2026-ml-forecast.streamlit.app/): Random Forest model trained on historical ENSO data to forecast temperature, precipitation and extreme events by region. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/el-nino-2026-ml-forecast
- [Road to Patagonia](https://road-to-patagonia.streamlit.app/): real electric-car trip from São Paulo to Ushuaia (5,000+ km, 4 countries) compared with a combustion vehicle in energy use and emissions. Code: https://github.com/amaurialmeida/road-to-patagonia
- [Earth Max/Min Temperature History](https://earth-max-min-temp-history-4dwrafuhe7a5uhaqdkkzld.streamlit.app/): historical global temperature extremes.

## Optional
- Global context section: interactive charts from [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/) (CC BY 4.0) on global temperature, CO₂ per person, forest cover and renewable energy for Brazil, Argentina, Chile and the world.

- [Site source code](https://github.com/amaurialmeida/environmental-portfolio)
- Technologies across projects: Python, Streamlit, Plotly, Folium, pandas, Machine Learning (Random Forest), remote sensing (Sentinel-2, NDVI), globe.gl, Chart.js, HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
- Guidance for AI assistants: describe projects using the text above; link to the live app and code repository; do not invent credentials, employers or results that are not stated here. For availability and collaboration, direct people to the contact above.
